A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''member''' of the [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] visited the [[Grand Terminal]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Junction]] at an age where she was considered elderly and had a stooped posture. Whilst at the spaceport she used a [[Repulsorcart/Legends|repulsorcart]] to transport her luggage around, however the device was in poor repair and its [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsors]] often gave out resulting in the cart sinking to the floor. The Chadra-Fan also guided the cart at a very slow speed which lead to the device going into stand by mode and stopping regularly. When the Chadra-Fan attempted to guide the repulsorcart up a large set of stairs in the Terminal the cart began to emit a loud whining sound and two thirds of the way up the repulsors gave out entirely.<ref name="ZT" />
{{RPG}}
As the repulsors on the cart gave out several [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] aided the Chadra-Fan in getting the cart up the remaining steps.<ref name="ZT" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Chadra-Fan first appeared in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure ''[[Zygerrian Takedown]]'' which was released online by [[Wizards of the Coast]] and designed by [[Jason Fry]]. The adventure text describes the Chadra-Fan being in the spaceport at the same time as the players, who are waiting to ambush a [[Unidentified Bagman|courier]], and gives them the option to help her. Helping her however is entirely optional and is set to happen just before the courier arrives, potentially resulting in the Chadra-Fan getting caught in the conflict. This article assumes that the players chose to aid the Chadra-Fan prior to ambushing the courier.
